cohort: A 34-year-old pregnant female patient in her 10th week of gestation with a history of cerebral venous thrombosis and Factor V Leiden mutation presented with an acute-on-chronic intracranial venous sinus thrombosis.
finding: In a case of severe intracranial venous sinus thrombosis refractory to anticoagulation, treatment with eptifibatide infusion followed by combined antiplatelet (ticagrelor, ASA) and anticoagulation therapy led to clinical improvement and regression of edema.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was performed at the 38th week of pregnancy, and the newborn was completely healthy.
